name: Death Trap marks the first enemy to approach it and deals 3100 plus attack power after a minute (#870)
contract: Death Trap 681450 (installed Spell.dbc) is a 60000 ms cooldown SUMMON of creature 506252 in front of the caster, duration 60 s. Tooltip: 'Place a death trap on the ground lasting 1 min that will curse the first enemy to approach it, marking them for death, causing them to take ... Shadow damage after 1 min.' Like Inquisitor's Trap it is implemented by spell_ascension_witch_hunter_summon and npc_ascension_witch_hunter_field (AscensionWitchHunterSummons.cpp): the creature's AI casts helper 681452 on the first valid enemy within 3 yd and despawns. Helper 681452 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE (Shadow) with base 499 die 1 and +100 per level over level 34 (level 60: 499 + 1 + 26 x 100 = 3100) and an amplitude of 59999 ms inside the 60000 ms duration, so it ticks once at the end; the module adds 1.0 x attack power through the WitchCoefficients row {681452, 0, 1.0 ap} (AscensionWitchHunterCoefficients.h). Enemy a stands on the caster (2 yd from the trap, within its 3 yd trigger radius) and enemy b 6 yd away (at least 4 yd from the trap, outside it), so only a is marked. Attack power is not a value this scenario may assume, so the aura amount and the delivered damage are bounded (3101 minimum shows the AP term contributed; 5000 maximum assumes attack power under 1900, an unverified assumption). The damage assertion polls for up to 75 s because the tick is a minute away; the hunter is the aura caster, so the damage log is attributed to it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Drop Death Trap in front of the hunter
The first enemy in reach is marked for death
An enemy 6 yd away is not marked
The mark holds 3100 (499 + 1 + 26 levels x 100) plus the attack power term
The mark runs for at most a minute
The mark's damage lands after the minute
